title: Personal Portfolio Site
description: Build a responsive personal portfolio using HTML and CSS. Must include navigation, project showcase grid, and contact form. Site must work on mobile (375px) and desktop (1440px).

title: Interactive Task Manager
description: Build a task manager SPA using React. Features: add/edit/delete tasks, filter by status, persist to localStorage. Must use functional components and hooks.

title: REST API for Task Manager
description: Build a Node.js/Express REST API for the task manager. Endpoints for CRUD operations on tasks and users. Include input validation and error handling middleware.

title: Database Integration
description: Connect your REST API to PostgreSQL. Design a schema for tasks, users, and categories. Write migrations and seed scripts. Implement at least 3 complex queries using joins.

title: Auth Implementation
description: Add JWT-based authentication to your API. Implement signup, login, logout, and protected routes. Store hashed passwords. Add role-based access (admin vs regular user).

title: Midterm Project — Pair Full-Stack App
description: In pairs, build a full-stack web application of your choice. Must include React frontend, Express API, PostgreSQL database, and user authentication. Graded on functionality, code quality, and documentation.

title: Final Capstone — Deployed Application
description: Solo project: build and deploy a complete web application to a cloud platform (Heroku, Railway, or AWS). Must include CI/CD pipeline via GitHub Actions. Graded on functionality, deployment, and a live demo presentation.

title: Performance Optimization Lab
description: Profile your capstone application using Lighthouse and Chrome DevTools. Identify and fix at least 3 performance bottlenecks. Write a report documenting before/after metrics.
